thesis: The episode argues that Seeing Machines has been forced into a mandatory European duopoly with Smart Eye, creating a high free cash flow business that some view as undervalued despite concerns about debt and receivables. Other companies discussed include Celsius, which faces distribution and fad risks; Baker Hughes, DoorDash, and Pershing Square entities, which are viewed as having growth or valuation premiums; and Driven Brands, Liberty Global, Stevanato, and Smart Eye, which present mixed or neutral cases regarding their specific operational or strategic risks.
